The separate-site routing decision does not alter which legacy content and images are reused for the new website.
The candidate already has a complete message-39 MODIFY establishing routing from the master website to each location's Wix website.
The candidate's message-39 INTRODUCE already records that each location has its own Wix website connected through the master website.
The existing message-39 MODIFY and RESUME already capture the separate Wix-account and payment-setup architecture supporting isolated payouts.
The candidate already has a message-39 MODIFY placing each location's calendar in its own Wix website and account.
Message 39 reiterates the already-recorded master domain and does not change its domain-to-website mapping.
The candidate's message-39 INTRODUCE already records that every location has its own Wix account.
The message-39 INTRODUCE already captures both location-specific payment processing and separate payment setups.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: That approach will work. We’ll use https://shatterhouse.example as the master website where visitors can learn about your brand and choose a location. Selecting a location like Ridgehaven or Harbor Valley will take the visitor to that location’s own Wix website, where bookings and payment processing will occur. Each location will therefore have its own Wix account, bookings, calendar, reporting, and payment setup, while everything remains connected through the main https://shatterhouse.example website.

value_updates.reporting_placement: Each location's reporting is maintained separately through that location's own Wix website and account.
